name: relay-team-builder
description: Build relay teams from Excel swimmer data

scripts.start:backend: cd ../backend && poetry run python -m uvicorn api_server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const d=path.join(process.cwd(),'dist');if(fs.existsSync(d)){fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true});console.log('Deleted dist');}const cache=path.join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA||process.env.USERPROFILE,'electron-builder','Cache');if(fs.existsSync(cache)){fs.rmSync(cache,{recursive:true});console.log('Deleted electron-builder cache');}const nmCache=path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','.cache');if(fs.existsSync(nmCache)){fs.rmSync(nmCache,{recursive:true});console.log('Deleted node_modules/.cache');}"
